goal: Abort bitcoind startup when configured ZMQ notification endpoints fail to bind or initialize
Alert operators immediately when socket setup fails instead of silently dropping notifications
reviewability: Branch is clean, CI passes, and all feedback has been addressed
agreement: Strong support with manual testing of invalid and conflicting configurations
Concept approval verified by testing varied ZMQ misconfigurations (pinheadmz)
Approach approval verified by checking that startup abort works as expected (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it prevents silent socket bind failures from hiding missing ZMQ notifications
Operators and downstream indexers are alerted immediately at startup instead of losing events
